items.source: Turns the AggregationExpression into a Document within the given AggregationOperationContext.
items.translation: 将给定的 AggregationExpression 转换为 Document，该转换在指定的 AggregationOperationContext 中进行。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the value pointed to by given fieldReference and converts it to an array.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式接收由给定字段引用指向的值并将其转换为数组。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the result value of the given expression and converts it to an array.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式接收给定表达式的结果值并将其转换为数组。

items.source: Append the given key at the position in the underlying LinkedHashMap.
items.translation: 在底层LinkedHashMap中，将给定的键追加到指定位置。

items.source: Creates new aggregation expression that takes the given value and converts it to an array.
items.translation: 创建一个新的聚合表达式，该表达式接收给定值并将其转换为数组。

items.source:
AggregationExpression for $objectToArray that converts a document to an array of documents that each contains two fields k and v.
NOTE: Requires MongoDB 3.6 or later.
items.translation:
AggregationExpression 用于 $objectToArray，该操作符将文档转换为包含两个字段 k 和 v 的文档数组。
注意：需要 MongoDB 3.6 或更高版本。
